- The Paris Agreement, along with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and the World Health Organization's climate change action plan, provides a framework for promoting sustainable practices within the healthcare sector. Healthcare is recognized as contributing significantly to climate change, with the industry representing 4.4% of global carbon dioxide emissions, despite its aim to promote good health [https://openalex.org/W3166839458||ABSTRACT||000].
- The three I's (Inequity, Interconnectedness, and Innovation) highlight challenges and opportunities for policy coherence with the Paris Agreement.
